lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Joel son of Pethuel, who told the elders to pass it down to their children.
Four kinds of locust ate the land, and an invading nation with a lion's teeth splintered the grapevine.
Grain and drink offerings were cut off from the house of the LORD, and the priests were in mourning.
Joel told the priests to wear sackcloth through the night and gather the elders at the house of the LORD to fast.
The herds wandered because they had no pasture, and fire consumed the open pastures and scorched the trees.
